factory.name: Heading.create | Text.create | Link.create | setLineClamp
factory.signature: Heading.create(level: HeadingLevel, text: string, options?: HeadingOptions, doc?: Document): HTMLHeadingElement; Text.create(text: string, options?: TextOptions, doc?: Document): HTMLParagraphElement | HTMLSpanElement; Link.create(options: LinkOptions, doc?: Document): HTMLAnchorElement; setLineClamp(el: HTMLElement, lines: number): () => void

options.name: size
options.description: Heading: visual size, default the level. Text: font size, default md.

options.name: href
options.description: Link: http(s) URL or relative reference; other schemes throw TYPOGRAPHY_OPTIONS.

options.name: text
options.description: Heading, Text, Link: text content (rendered with textContent).

options.name: external
options.description: Link: target=_blank, rel="noopener noreferrer", and a visually hidden localized "(opens in a new tab)".

options.name: muted
options.description: Link: muted color; the underline remains.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the external-link hint (Link.create option or global).

methods.name: Heading.enhance
methods.description: Since 0.9.0. Style an existing h1..h6 (level from the tag).

methods.name: Text.enhance
methods.description: Since 0.9.0. Add aui-text modifiers to an existing element.

methods.name: Link.enhance
methods.signature: Link.enhance(a: HTMLAnchorElement, options?: LinkEnhanceOptions): TypographyEnhancement<LinkEnhanceOptions> & { check(): void }
methods.description: Since 0.9.0. Style and validate an existing link; destroy() restores target and rel.

methods.name: isSafeHref
methods.description: The link destination check used by Link and Card.

cssClasses.name: aui-heading--1 ... aui-heading--6
cssClasses.description: Visual sizes font-size-4xl, 3xl, 2xl, xl, lg, md.

cssClasses.name: aui-link
cssClasses.description: Underlined color-link link with a focus ring; LinkText in forced colors.

cssClasses.name: aui-prose
cssClasses.description: Rich text rhythm for p, lists, h2 to h4, links, code, pre, and blockquote (line-height-relaxed).

cssClasses.name: --aui-lines
cssClasses.description: Custom property: number of lines for aui-line-clamp.
